title: A Week of Symfony #1031
content: <html><head></head><body>This week, Symfony 6.4.47, 7.4.20, and 8.1.8 were released, along with Symfony Reprise 1.3.0. Meanwhile, we continued introducing Symfony 8.2 features, including OpenID Connect login, PGP/MIME signed and encrypted emails, sudo mode, more flexible serialization…</body></html>
author: Javier Eguiluz
